predicted: Random partner sampling has been the project's unexamined default, so this is a genuine two-sided test. I predict same_prefix (regional) partners give HIGHER benefit than random for starved targets, because a neighbouring zip3 shares an economy and its coefficients transfer, and that cross_prefix sits below random. I predict the SIGN of the rule is unchanged in every strategy -- adequate targets still lose -- because target adequacy, not partner identity, sets the sign (R45/R47). NOTE this prediction uses no transferred constant. If same_prefix and cross_prefix are indistinguishable, partner correlation does not matter and Section 8's limitation is closable by citing this null.
